steps.text: Open the pro signup page for the Marketing occupation.
If a service list shows, keep the Marketing selection and click Next. When the modal 'New customers are waiting' shows, click 'Sign up with email'.
Fill the password field with the password from vault item {vault_item} (vault fill helper only; never type or print it).
Leave BOTH SMS opt-in boxes UNCHECKED. They default to checked: uncheck each, then confirm both read unchecked.
Click 'Sign up'. This creates the account for {business_name} and is the send.
When the page says "We'll text you a verification code", run the helper `sent` command now. Then wait for the client's code with `code` and enter it.
